sloka: तौ तावदहम्द्यैव वक्ष्यामि शृणु मे वचः ।अभिषेकसमारम्भओ राघवस्योपकल्पितः ॥२-११-२४॥
transliteration: tau tāvadahamdyaiva vakṣyāmi śṛṇu me vacaḥ ।abhiṣekasamārambhao rāghavasyopakalpitaḥ ॥2-11-24॥

translations.english: Preparations for Rama's consecration have been made. With these very materials for installation, my son Bharata should be consecrated.
